intent: Inspect and refactor EventLogRepository without changing its tabled contract or the frozen tests; keep it consistent with: Append-only repository port. append inserts one row (never update/delete); revision is 1 for the first row of a (deviceId, metric, tDevice) key, otherwise one more than the highest existing revision; kind is RECORD for revision 1 else REVISION. findLatest returns the highest revision of a key or completes empty.
